get_rule.description: Get the cipai structure before drafting. The text argument must contain only the cipai or rule name, e.g. "疏影". Never include the poem title, prompt, draft, explanation, or theme.

check_judou.description: Check only the poem body's character count and judou break positions. The text argument must be only the ci body with punctuation/newlines. Do not include title, cipai label, prompt, notes, or explanation.
